introHtml: The Goods backpacks are built from recycled PET materials, making them a smart choice for sustainability-focused companies. Whether you are outfitting your sales team with branded gear or giving eco-friendly gifts at a trade show, these backpacks offer a durable, professional look. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a polished finish that aligns with your green initiatives.
